# Nam Hin Bee Kee Contractor (南欣美記承建商)

> HDB-registered renovation contractor in Singapore, operating as a sole proprietor since 21 November 1984 (HDB Reg No. 33738700A). Over 40 years of experience. Customers deal directly with the contractor, with no middlemen.

## Services
Full renovation, electrical works, plumbing and sanitary, carpentry and joinery, hacking and masonry, tiling, painting, doors and windows.

## Property types
HDB 3-room, 4-room, 5-room and EA flats; condos; terrace and semi-detached houses; bungalows; shophouses. Service area: Singapore.
